questions.prompt: The Ottoman Empire was a highly successful Islamic dynasty, famously known for conquering Constantinople and bringing an end to the Byzantine Empire. Unfortunately, the empire eventually collapsed after losing World War I alongside Germany and Austria-Hungary. Apart from its defeat by the Allied Powers, which of the following was the main underlying cause of the decline and eventual collapse of the Ottoman Empire?
choices: The failure to assimilate the cultures of Anatolia with the newly conquered territories in Eastern Europe.
The shift from transnational religious loyalty (Ukhuwah) toward loyalty based on ethnicity and territorial identity (modern Asabiyyah).
The reluctance of traditional scholars to adopt Sharia-compliant banking systems based on fiat money in global trade.
The absolute dominance of Sufi orders in determining tactical military policies on the empire's frontiers.
